title: The Subscription Audit: Find $50 a Month in 15 Minutes

lines.say: How many subscriptions are you paying for right now?
Most people guess low. Here's a fifteen-minute audit, with real numbers.

scene.head: LOOK IN 3 PLACES
items: Last 2 months of bank and card statements

lines.say: Check three places: your last two bank and card statements, your phone's app store subscriptions, and your email for receipts and renewals.

lines.cap: Nine subscriptions. $126 a month. Over $1,500 a year.
lines.say: Nine subscriptions. A hundred twenty-six dollars a month. Over fifteen hundred a year.
Step two. Sort them: keep, rotate, or cut.
Keep one streaming service, and rotate the others. Subscribe for a month when there's a show you want, then cancel.
Cut the fitness app. You already pay for a gym.
And the delivery membership got used twice. Cut it.
From a hundred twenty-six a month, down to seventy-eight.

scene.label: Found in 15 minutes
scene.sub: a year ($48 a month), almost the whole holiday fund from episode four

lines.cap: That's $48 a month, or $576 a year.
lines.say: That's forty-eight dollars a month, or five seventy-six a year.
Step three. Stop it from creeping back.

scene.head: KEEP IT CLEAN
items: Calendar reminder before every free trial ends

lines.say: Put a reminder on your calendar the day before every free trial ends. Move annual renewals into your surprise fund, so they're planned. And redo this audit every six months.

scene.text: Found money needs a job, today.

lines.cap: And give the $48 a job right away, or it'll quietly get spent somewhere else.
lines.say: And give the forty-eight a job right away, or it'll quietly get spent somewhere else.
